name: Ultra-wide (14-20 mm FF-equivalent)
definition: Very wide field of view; used close, it exaggerates near-far size differences (the cause is camera distance, not the lens - LENS_OPTICS §2).
how: Get close to make space dramatic; keep faces away from frame edges (marginal stretch).
purpose: immersive space, small rooms made big, comedy faces, action POV
story_use: the world crowds in on the character; energetic, comic or unsettling
emotional_effect: energy, distortion, unease when close to faces [CRAFT]
close-range face photos are rated less trustworthy/attractive (va:BryanPeronaAdolphs2012) [EVIDENCE]
ai_image_prompt: ultra-wide 16mm lens, close to the subject, exaggerated perspective, interior space looks large
ai_video_prompt: Ultra-wide shot close to the skateboarder as he rolls past the camera.
ai_notes: FLUX: lens/DoF words push non-photo styles toward a 3D photo look (CAPABILITY_MATRIX flux-schnell-local) - omit lens words for pencil/charcoal styles.
common_mistakes: blaming the lens for perspective distortion caused by being close
check: Are faces near the centre? Is the distortion intended?

name: Wide (24-28 mm)
definition: Wide but natural-looking at medium distance; roughly a phone's main camera (23-26 mm eq., LENS_OPTICS §1).
story_use: the character belongs to (or is lost in) a place
avoid_when: tight CU of faces (go longer and farther)
ai_image_prompt: 24mm lens, wide shot, the shop interior and the customer both in frame
ai_video_prompt: Wide 24mm shot, the camera glides behind the customer into the shop.
check: Subject not at the extreme edge.

name: Moderate wide (35 mm)
definition: Storytelling 'one lens' focal length: environment plus readable faces at MS.
story_use: observational intimacy - close to the character without isolating them
ai_image_prompt: 35mm lens, medium shot, natural perspective, the room visible behind
ai_video_prompt: 35mm medium shot, slow push-in as she explains.

name: Normal (40-60 mm)
definition: 'Normal' ≈ format diagonal (43 mm FF). It looks natural only when viewed from near the centre of projection; on phones held ~30 cm, natural-looking focal lengths are longer (va:CooperPiazzaBanks2012; LENS_OPTICS §1).
avoid_when: you want a strong optical signature
common_mistakes: assuming 50 mm looks 'normal' on a phone feed
check: For phones consider 70-100 mm-equivalent looks for people/products (DERIVED in LENS_OPTICS).

name: Portrait / short tele (85-105 mm)
definition: Lets the camera stand ~1.5 m+ from a face for MCU/CU - true face proportions and soft backgrounds.
how: MCU/CU, f/2-2.8, focus on the near eye.
emotional_effect: longer camera distance -> faces rated more trustworthy than close shots (va:BryanPeronaAdolphs2012) [EVIDENCE]
ai_image_prompt: portrait of a woman trying on glasses, 85mm lens, photographed from 1.5 m, f/2, shallow depth of field, eyes sharp
ai_video_prompt: 85mm close-up, shallow focus on her eyes as she adjusts her new glasses.
ai_notes: Prompt hint borrowed from lens_examples lens.portrait_try_on_85.
common_mistakes: closer than ~1 m reintroduces big-nose effect

name: Telephoto (135-200 mm)
definition: Narrow view from far away; background appears stacked close to the subject (because of distance - 'compression' is a misnomer, LENS_OPTICS §2).
how: Shoot from far; a small background area fills the frame -> simple, melted backgrounds.
purpose: isolation, voyeurism, crowded streets stacked, heat-haze drama
story_use: the character trapped by/against the world; watched from afar
use_when: isolating a person in a crowd
product against a clean melted background
ai_image_prompt: telephoto 200mm lens, shot from far away, the woman isolated in a crowded street, background stacked and blurred
ai_video_prompt: Long-lens telephoto shot from across the street; she walks toward camera through the crowd, background stacked and soft.
check: Is the 'watched from afar' feeling intended?

name: Super-telephoto (300 mm+)
definition: Extremely narrow view from very far: huge sun/moon behind a figure, stacked city layers, wildlife/sports.
how: Very long distance; stabilise; atmospheric haze becomes visible.
purpose: spectacle compositions (figure against giant moon), heat shimmer
ai_image_prompt: super-telephoto 600mm shot, a tiny figure on a hill silhouetted against a gigantic setting sun
ai_video_prompt: Super-telephoto shot of a figure on a ridge silhouetted against a huge rising moon, heat shimmer, locked-off.

name: Macro (1:1 or closer)
definition: Focuses close enough to render small objects life-size on the sensor; DOF becomes millimetres (LENS_OPTICS §3).
how: Stop down / focus-stack for stills; tiny moves look huge.
story_use: the detail IS the story (a scratch, a hinge, an engraving)
avoid_when: without first showing the whole object
ai_image_prompt: macro photograph of an eyeglass hinge, 1:1 magnification, razor-thin depth of field, specular highlights
ai_video_prompt: Macro shot sliding slowly along the edge of a lens as light glints across the coating.
ai_notes: AI often invents extra parts at macro scale - compare with the real product.
common_mistakes: moving the camera fast at macro scale - becomes chaos
check: Product details match the real item.

name: Probe lens (wide macro tube)
definition: Long thin barrel with a wide-angle macro view (85° AoV, 2:1 to infinity, built-in ring light per retail specs) that can travel among objects (Laowa-Probe).
how: Move the tip between products/food at ground level; needs lots of light (f/14).
story_use: makes small objects feel like a landscape
ai_image_prompt: probe lens bug's-eye view between rows of eyeglasses on a display, wide-angle macro, the frames tower like buildings
ai_video_prompt: Probe lens shot gliding low between rows of eyeglasses on a table, the frames towering overhead.
ai_notes: Untested whether models know the term - add the description ('wide-angle macro, camera at object level').

name: Anamorphic
definition: Squeezes a wide image horizontally onto the sensor (desqueezed in post). Signatures: vertical oval bokeh, horizontal streak flares, wide aspect (Cooke-Anamorphic; NFS-AnamorphicBokeh).
how: Front-anamorphic element before the iris gives the oval bokeh; lower squeeze ratios weaken the traits.
purpose: 'big cinema' look, flares in night city scenes
use_when: 16:9/2.39 widescreen pieces, night scenes with practical lights
ai_image_prompt: anamorphic lens look, vertical oval bokeh, horizontal blue streak flare from a street light, 2.39:1 framing, night city
ai_video_prompt: Anamorphic widescreen shot of a car passing at night, horizontal blue lens flares streak across the frame.
ai_notes: Prompt the visible signatures (oval bokeh, streak flare), not only the word 'anamorphic'.
common_mistakes: fake streak flares on every light
check: Bokeh shape vertical oval; flares motivated by a light source.

name: Tilt (Scheimpflug) - miniature / wedge DOF
definition: Tilting the lens rotates the plane of focus, giving a wedge-shaped DOF: either a whole inclined plane sharp or a thin sharp band - the 'miniature' look (Canon-TSE).
how: High angle + thin focus band + saturated colours = toy town.
story_use: the world as a model - playful or god-like
ai_image_prompt: tilt-shift miniature effect, high angle over a busy market, thin band of sharp focus, toy-like saturated colours
ai_video_prompt: Tilt-shift miniature-style time-lapse of a busy intersection from high above.
ai_notes: Luma key 'tiny_planet' is a different effect (stereographic), do not confuse.
common_mistakes: eye-level tilt-shift - the miniature illusion needs a high angle

name: Shift (perspective control)
definition: Shifting moves the image circle without moving the camera, keeping verticals parallel when the camera stays level (Canon-TSE).
how: Keep the camera level and shift up to include the top of a building.
purpose: architecture and storefronts with straight verticals
ai_image_prompt: architectural photo of a shopfront, perfectly vertical lines, shift lens perspective correction, level camera
ai_video_prompt: Locked-off level shot of the shopfront with perfectly straight verticals; people pass by.
common_mistakes: pitched camera then 'fixing' in post - crops a lot

name: Fisheye
definition: Non-rectilinear lens (curved straight lines) with ~180° view.
how: Use for peepholes, skate/sports, surreal POV.
avoid_when: products and faces you want true
ai_image_prompt: fisheye lens view through a door peephole, curved walls, a figure waiting outside
ai_video_prompt: Fisheye peephole view: a delivery man approaches the door and knocks.
check: Motivated by a device or POV.

name: Shallow depth of field
focal_length_mm: any; f/1.4-2.8, close focus, long lens
definition: Thin sharp zone; background/foreground blur. DOF depends on aperture, focus distance, focal length and format/CoC (LENS_OPTICS §3). Blur can also change perceived scale/distance (va:Held2010).
how: Wide aperture, near focus, longer lens, larger format.
purpose: isolate the subject, direct the eye, intimacy
story_use: the character's inner world - the rest fades
emotional_effect: strong blur gradients can make scenes look miniature (va:Held2010) [EVIDENCE]
ai_image_prompt: very shallow depth of field, f/1.8, subject sharp, background melted into soft bokeh
ai_video_prompt: A cinematic close-up portrait of a woman sitting in a café at night, with a very shallow depth of field.
ai_notes: Veo example quoted. FLUX: DoF words push illustration styles toward photo (CAPABILITY_MATRIX).
common_mistakes: focus on the glasses frame instead of the eye
everything blurred including the subject's far eye in CU (fine) vs nose (wrong)
check: Focus on the nearest eye (or the product hero detail).

name: Deep focus
definition: Near and far both sharp (wide lens, small aperture, hyperfocal focusing - LENS_OPTICS §3).
how: Stage action in depth so the viewer chooses where to look.
purpose: staging in depth, comedy in the background, establishing
story_use: relationships between foreground and background characters
avoid_when: you need to force a single focus on a phone
ai_image_prompt: deep focus, everything sharp from the foreground glasses on the counter to the customer at the door, 24mm, f/11
ai_video_prompt: Deep-focus wide shot; in the foreground the optician works, in the background a customer enters. Locked-off.
common_mistakes: no depth staging - deep focus wasted
check: Is there meaningful action on two planes?

name: Sensor size & crop factor
definition: Same field of view on smaller sensors needs shorter focal lengths; equivalent DOF needs the f-number × crop factor (LENS_OPTICS §1, DERIVED from va:Nasse2010-Zeiss).
how: Always speak in FF-equivalent focal lengths in prompts and shot lists; note phones (~24-26 mm eq. main) have deep DOF natively.
purpose: consistent planning across phones, cine cameras and AI prompts
story_use: phone footage = deep focus 'reality'; large format = shallow 'cinema' [CRAFT]
use_when: mixing phone footage with AI/cine shots - match look

examples.note: Shot on large-format ARRI Alexa Mini LF (per press coverage)

ai_image_prompt: shot on a full-frame cinema camera, 50mm equivalent
ai_notes: Models do not simulate sensors; describe the visible result (DOF, FOV) instead.
common_mistakes: quoting a phone's real focal length (e.g. 6 mm) in prompts

name: Flare, ghosts & coatings
definition: Internal reflections create veiling flare and ghost images; coatings reduce them; 'special flare' coatings deliberately add them (Cooke-Anamorphic SF).
how: Motivate flare by a visible light; for coating demos compare before/after (lens.coating_ghost_demo).
purpose: warmth, sun, vintage character; or demonstrating AR coatings
ai_image_prompt: warm sun flare from the top left, soft veiling glare, golden hour
ai_video_prompt: Golden-hour shot as the sun flares across the lens while she turns toward camera.
common_mistakes: flare with no light source in frame
